per_cell.name: One representative per cell
per_cell.calculation: pool all retained draws of the cell's selected windows, equal weight per window, and select the SGM
per_cell.interpretation: variation between cell representatives over the declared acquisition period

per_window_position.name: One representative per window position
per_window_position.calculation: at each selected position, pool the retained draws across the included cells, equal weight per cell, and select the SGM
per_window_position.interpretation: variation between acquisition-period representatives, cell differences compressed at each position

global.name: One representative of the selected collection
global.calculation: pool the retained draws with equal cell weight and equal selected-window weight within each cell, and select the SGM
global.interpretation: an overall joint center of the selected collection

per_cell_window.name: One representative per cell-window pair
per_cell_window.calculation: the SGM of each included cell-window posterior
per_cell_window.interpretation: variation between window representatives, cell and window identities retained

coverage_note: Complete cohort: MET-FAB 60 of 60 cells, 600 of 600 windows. The original MAP and summary references above come from the adopted product; the aggregation summaries come from the retained collections named below, fresh draws of the same estimator that do not reconstruct the original sampling attempt.
metric: estimator coordinates divided by the prior widths (sgm_scale)

methods.single_window: the window's stored exact sample medoid (reused) or the exact medoid
methods.pooled: exact medoid up to 10000 rows; above it the collection kernel's Weiszfeld geometric median snapped to the nearest retained draw (weiszfeld_snap), an approximation to the exact medoid
methods.quantiles: mixture quantiles of the pooled draws in estimator coordinates (numpy linear interpolation); physical endpoints are the transform of the quantile
methods.representative_quantiles: inverse weighted empirical CDF (smallest value with cumulative weight >= p)

contract.coordinate_transform: parameterization.to_flow (log10 for log rows, linear rows as-is)
contract.input_conversion: read_cell_chunks(domain='stored'): 16-bit raw frames to 8-bit, normalize_video in the sampler
contract.input_conversion_status: verified: every source (60) records the same input conversion; the reference product does not record one

mu_r.source: adopted Fab detector estimator C128V42A, record ..._FAB_2S_50FPS_C128V42A_MAP_Experiment, median over the 600 per-window posterior medians (ten 2 s windows of the sixty recordings), transformed to physical units; MAP and SGM aggregates read beside it (MAP 1.737, SGM 1.738). Neural estimate supported by synthetic recovery (MAE 0.011 dex, r 0.98 on the 25,000 EVAL videos of the current model, DETECTOR_WORKFLOW.md sec. 9.10); replaces the direct PSF-width estimate 1.585 selected before, which becomes the sensitivity scenario SEL_MU_R
mu_r.limitation: a demonstrated synthetic accuracy, no demonstrated experimental one; 7 % of windows above the 2.0 px prior edge; the direct estimator disagrees by 0.04 dex with no ground truth to decide; the fitted width falls 0.03 dex along a recording, which no fixed value represents; point estimate retained as produced, precision not established

sigma_r.source: adopted Fab detector estimator C128V42A, same record and aggregation (MAP 0.178, SGM 0.176); supported by the direct PSF-width cross-check 0.21 and the fit-corrected localization reference about 0.15 (sec. 6.7). Neural estimate supported by synthetic recovery (MAE 0.034 dex, r 0.98)
sigma_r.limitation: falls 0.15 dex along a recording in 92 % of recordings, a within-recording decline no fixed value represents; experimental accuracy model-dependent

mu_pc.source: adopted Fab detector estimator C128V42A, same record and aggregation (MAP 105.3, SGM 104.8). Neural estimate supported by synthetic recovery (MAE 0.028 dex, r 0.98)
mu_pc.limitation: no independent experimental cross-check (the localization per-detection brightness 386 is a spot-level sum, sec. 6.7 caveat 3); 8 to 14 % of windows below the 100-photon prior edge; falls 0.03 dex along a recording; a per-dye window median under the labeling and camera assumptions

sigma_pc.source: adopted Fab detector estimator C128V42A, same record and aggregation (MAP 0.5779, SGM 0.5861); fit-corrected localization reference about 0.5. Neural estimate supported by synthetic recovery (MAE 0.079 dex, r 0.90, the weakest of the four spatial and brightness parameters)

prob_photo_bleach.source: empirically anchored: a declared per-dye bleaching probability, anchored to the measured whole-recording fluorescence decline of the sixty MET-FAB recordings over 20 s (0.054 to 0.057 per 100-frame interval on the 16-bit frames; record ..._20S_50FPS_Direct_Fluorescence_Loss_Experiment_RAW), rounded as a working value, selected on 2026-10-01 from the overlay of single-rate declines on the measured curves (figures/field_flux_curves_FAB.png). The adopted estimator's own value (median 0.093, MAP 0.148) plays no part: it does not recover the parameter (r 0.06, MAE comparable to a constant guess). Probability over the fixed 100-frame reference interval
prob_photo_bleach.limitation: the analysis measures the field-fluorescence decline, not per-dye bleaching; the mapping to the simulator's per-dye probability rests on the assumptions recorded in DETECTOR_WORKFLOW.md sec. 7.6 (ideal independent dyes of stationary mean brightness); the recorded decline is not single-exponential and is stronger in brighter recordings; the background itself falls 9 %; emitters leaving the field and label exchange are not separable from bleaching; the late-phase rate 0.03 and the faster-loss value 0.10 are the declared sensitivity scenarios SEL_PB03 and SEL_PB10

lambda_rate.source: declared, rounded from the adopted Fab detector estimator C128V42A (median 8.096 per second, MAP 8.204, SGM 7.884; window spread 0.07 dex), the neural value being the default source under the hierarchy; partially recovered (MAE 0.217 dex, r 0.49), so its digits are not retained; replaces the nominal 5 chosen before. The localization-autocorrelation anchor about 5 (sec. 6.5) sits 0.21 dex below, comparable in magnitude to the synthetic mean absolute error
lambda_rate.limitation: not a uniquely measured rate; nothing on the recordings decides between 8 and the anchor 5; rises 0.06 dex along a recording; correlation time 0.12 s

selection.joint_uncertainty: none (a user-selected, fixed vector; no calibrated joint uncertainty)
